  # Session Handover — Wiki Memory Engine Test Plan

  > **Project:** Wiki Memory Engine (`wm`, `.wm/`)
  > **Spec:** @wiki/concepts/specs/local-knowledge-engine-rust
  > **State:** 19 MCP tools built, 19 tests passing, 7 commits
  > **Goal for next session:** Validate that the engine works end-to-end by running through all workflows

  ---
  id: wiki:howto:session-handover-test-plan

  ## Quick Start

  ```bash
  cd C:\Users\hk\.kimaki\projects\vpp-rag
  cargo build
  cargo test
  ```

  ## 1. wm-init — Session Initialization

  Walk through the wm-init skill (`.wm/skills/wm-init.md`):

  ### 1.1 Read AGENTS.md
  Check `.wm/AGENTS.md` exists (auto-generated by `wm init`).

  ### 1.2 Call initial state
  ```bash
  cargo run -- serve
  ```
  In another terminal, send an MCP initialize request:
  ```
  {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"initialize","params":{},"id":1}
  ```
  Expected: returns protocol version + server info + instructions to call wm_initial.

  ### 1.3 Check stale sources
  Via MCP:
  ```
  {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"wm_source.list","arguments":{"state":"pending"}},"id":2}
  ```

  ## 2. Page CRUD — Create and Query Wiki Pages

  ### 2.1 Create a concept page
  ```bash
  cargo run -- page list --json
  ```
  Verify the 4 existing wiki pages are indexed.

  ### 2.2 Search the wiki
  ```bash
  cargo run -- search "ArcSwap" --json
  cargo run -- search "tokenizer" --json
  cargo run -- search "prefix" --json
  ```
  Expected: returns matched pages with scores.

  ### 2.3 Get a page
  ```bash
  cargo run -- page get patterns:arc-swap-graph --json
  ```
  Expected: returns frontmatter + content.

  ### 2.4 Create a new page programmatically
  Via MCP:
  ```json
  {
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "method": "tools/call",
    "params": {
      "name": "wm_page.create",
      "arguments": {
        "path": "wiki/concepts/test-concept.md",
        "title": "Test Concept",
        "content": "# Test

  This is a test page created via MCP."
      }
    },
    "id": 3
  }
  ```

  ### 2.5 Update a page
  Via MCP:
  ```json
  {
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "method": "tools/call",
    "params": {
      "name": "wm_page.update",
      "arguments": {
        "id": "wiki:patterns:arc-swap-graph",
        "status": "reviewed"
      }
    },
    "id": 4
  }
  ```

  ## 3. Source State Machine — Ingest a File

  ### 3.1 Create a test source file
  ```bash
  echo "---
  title: Test Spec
  type: spec
  ---
  id: wiki:howto:session-handover-test-plan

  # Test Spec

  FR-1: The system must do X" > C:\Users\hk\.kimaki\projects\vpp-rag\.wm\sources	est-spec.yaml
  ```

  ### 3.2 Add via MCP
  ```json
  {
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "method": "tools/call",
    "params": {
      "name": "wm_source.add",
      "arguments": { "path": ".wm/sources/test-spec.yaml" }
    },
    "id": 5
  }
  ```

  ### 3.3 Process the source
  ```json
  {
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "method": "tools/call",
    "params": {
      "name": "wm_source.process",
      "arguments": { "id": "src_<hash>" }
    },
    "id": 6
  }
  ```

  ### 3.4 Complete with pages
  ```json
  {
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "method": "tools/call",
    "params": {
      "name": "wm_source.complete",
      "arguments": {
        "id": "src_<hash>",
        "page_refs": ["wiki:specs:local-knowledge-engine-rust"]
      }
    },
    "id": 7
  }
  ```

  ## 4. Graph Navigation — Explore Relationships

  ```bash
  cargo run -- graph neighbors ":.:wm:wiki:patterns:arc-swap-graph" --json
  ```

  Expected: returns neighbors connected via relates_to edges.

  ## 5. Search.retrieve — Context Assembly

  Via MCP:
  ```json
  {
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "method": "tools/call",
    "params": {
      "name": "wm_search.retrieve",
      "arguments": {
        "q": "ArcSwap",
        "token_budget": 4096
      }
    },
    "id": 8
  }
  ```

  Expected: returns context pack with match node + related pages, within token budget.

  ## 6. Lint + Validate

  ```bash
  cargo run -- lint
  cargo run -- validate
  ```

  ## 7. Index Rebuild

  Via MCP:
  ```json
  {
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "method": "tools/call",
    "params": {
      "name": "wm_index.rebuild",
      "arguments": {}
    },
    "id": 9
  }
  ```

  ## 8. Task Management

  ### 8.1 Check ACs
  ```json
  {
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "method": "tools/call",
    "params": {
      "name": "wm_task.check_ac",
      "arguments": { "id": "wiki:specs:<spec>", "criteria": ["1"] }
    },
    "id": 10
  }
  ```

  ## Known Issues / Gaps

  | Gap | Status | Impact |
  |-----|--------|--------|
  | `relates_to` YAML in frontmatter not materialized as graph edges | Parser parses, graph builder needs update | Edges = 0 always |
  | CLI path resolution prepends `.:.wm:wiki:` prefix | Cosmetic — paths work | IDs are ugly |
  | Only 19 of ~47 spec tools built | Ongoing | Missing: graph.path/subgraph/stats, page.delete, project.detect/set |
  | Rotating file logger not implemented | Low priority | All logs go to stderr |
  | Audit channel receiver works but no audit events emitted | Medium | Events sent but no handler calls audit_sender.send() |
  | Skills reference tools that exist now | Check updated | wm-page.update, wm-search.retrieve now live |
